overview.title: Ironworks Dynasty at a glance
overview.description: How the league is organized, what defines the current season, and where to find its records.

paragraphs: 2026 is the active Ironworks season, played on Sleeper as a 12-team dynasty league.
Ironworks has continuous league history since 2012. Game-by-game records begin with the 2022 Sleeper season.
Every completed season from 2012 through 2025 is archived, with champions and franchise history kept.

story.title: Our Story: Ironworks
story.teaser: Ironworks started in 2012 as a two-keeper redraft league for the crew at the old foundry.
